patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-fashion photography and video are used as primary visual elements, often spanning the full width of the viewport to create an immersive experience.
Consistent use of a clean, modern sans-serif typeface with clear hierarchy, often employing small uppercase text for navigation and product labels.
A stark, high-contrast palette of white and black, punctuated by a vibrant, deep red accent color for calls to action and highlights, creating visual tension and focus.
The top announcement bar and the main navigation bar remain sticky at the top of the viewport as the page content scrolls underneath, maintaining constant access to key links.
Editorial-style content blocks feature large, impactful imagery paired with concise text, breaking up product displays and adding a storytelling dimension to the site.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header system where both a top announcement bar and the primary navigation persist at the top of the screen during scroll, ensuring consistent brand presence and navigation access.
Hero sections utilize full-width video (as indicated by 'video-hero' tech) or large, high-resolution photography to immediately establish brand aesthetic and product focus.
Product displays are organized in clean, responsive grids that adapt to different screen sizes, showcasing items with minimal surrounding UI to keep focus on the product itself.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, and small, uppercase labels are used for navigation and product details.
design_tokens.radius: sharp across all elements, including product images, buttons, and structural containers.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between main content sections and ample whitespace around elements, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-fashion, editorial photography and video creates an immersive brand experience that elevates the products beyond mere e-commerce listings. The minimalist design acts as a sophisticated canvas, allowing the striking visuals to convey a strong sense of luxury and style.
